## History

Emily is a student from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) who attends Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) alongside her peers. During her time at the academy, she resides in town and socializes with her fellow classmates. Her activities include visiting [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at her boarding house along with [Jane](../character/jane.md) and Ruby to share local news.
